app.title: GalaxyTerm
app.subtitle: Extensible terminal workspace
error.app.title: GalaxyTerm could not render this workspace
error.app.description: The interface encountered an unexpected error. Connection profiles and local data were not cleared, so the workspace can be recovered after reloading.
operation.error.reason.validation: Connection details are incomplete or invalid
operation.error.reason.generic: The operation could not be completed
operation.error.suggestion.timeout: Check that the target is reachable, then retry. Increase the timeout only when the service is known to respond slowly.
operation.error.suggestion.authenticatio: Review the username, authentication method, and saved credential before trying again.
operation.error.suggestion.permission: Confirm the remote account and target path have permission for this operation.
operation.error.suggestion.unavailable: Enable or install the required provider, then reopen the connection.
operation.error.suggestion.validation: Review the highlighted connection fields and correct them before trying again.
operation.error.suggestion.network: Check the host, port, VPN, proxy, and firewall, then retry.
operation.error.suggestion.package: Use a package from a trusted release and verify that it matches this platform and GalaxyTerm API version.
operation.error.suggestion.generic: Review the details, correct the related configuration, and try the operation again.

connection.empty.group.title: This group is empty

session.audit.pending.title: Audit pending save

session.audit.saved.title: Audit record saved
session.audit.saved.description: A record with {count} events is saved and can be reviewed, replayed, or exported from Audit.
session.audit.closedPending.title: Closed session pending audit
session.audit.closedPending.description: This session is closed but the record is not marked saved yet. Save it manually or confirm it on the Audit page.
session.empty.title: Open a terminal session
session.empty.description: Start from a local shell, SSH profile, or saved connection. Sessions keep running until you close the tab.
session.empty.restoreUnavailable: No saved workspace is available yet

confirm.closeClosedSessionsContent: {count} closed sessions will be cleared after saving their audit records.
confirm.closeOtherSessionsContent: {count} sessions except the current one will be closed after saving their audit records.
confirm.clearCommandHistoryContent: {count} filtered commands in {scope} will be removed. Favorites on those entries are removed too.
welcome.title: Open a session to start working

extension.officialHint: Official extensions can be distributed through GitHub Releases or offline .gtx packages
extension.sourceHint: Save GitHub Release or offline package index locations
extension.sourceDrawerHint: Use an HTTPS GitHub repository, Releases page, or direct galaxyterm-index.json URL. GalaxyTerm selects the package for this device and verifies its SHA-256 before installation.
terminal.error.recoveryHint: Check the connection and retry. Copy the error or open the audit record when more detail is needed.
terminal.confirmPaste: Large or multi-line paste detected. Send it to the terminal?
confirm.terminalPasteContent: Paste {characters} characters across {lines} lines into the current terminal.
confirm.terminalPasteWarning: Multi-line content may execute immediately after pasting. Verify the clipboard contents and current connection target before continuing.
validation.remoteEntryName: Enter a name without slashes, backslashes, or path traversal
validation.extensionSourceHttps: Use an HTTPS URL without embedded credentials
sort.name: Name
settings.autoSaveHint: Saves tabs, split view, and non-sensitive connection metadata.
settings.autoRestoreHint: Only local sessions are auto-restored. Remote passwords and private keys are never saved.
settings.terminalDefaultsHint: New terminals use this type and local working directory first. Saved connections keep their own values.
settings.coreOnly: Only the lightweight core is enabled. K8s, Docker, and database terminals will be installed as extensions.
settings.extensionPackageHint: .gtx is a GalaxyTerm extension package. It is a zip file containing manifest.json.
settings.secretsHint: Connections, workspaces, recent connections, imports, and exports never save passwords, private keys, or passphrases in plain text. When credential saving is enabled, secrets are written to the system credential store.
settings.dangerousConfirmHint: Closing sessions, closing all sessions, deleting connections, and similar dangerous actions require confirmation by default.
settings.logLevelHint: Controls the detail level of UI diagnostics. Audit records and recordings are still saved from session events independently.
settings.shortcutModifierHint: Global shortcuts now use {shortcut}. They do not fire inside text fields or terminal search.
settings.credentialHint: When enabled, passwords, private keys, passphrases, and jump-host passwords are saved to the system credential store. Connection profiles and exports only keep a credential reference.
settings.auditHint: Audit records include session events, output recordings, and operation summaries by default. Passwords, tokens, private keys, and common secrets are redacted before export.
settings.sshConfigImportHint: Parses Host, HostName, User, Port, and IdentityFile metadata only. It does not read private key files or save passwords.
file.browserHint: Choose an installed protocol, open a directory, and reuse saved credentials when supported.
file.noProviderHint: Install an SFTP, FTP, S3, or compatible file-provider extension to browse remote files.
tunnel.formHint: Forward a local port to a remote service through an SSH gateway.
tunnel.listHint: Running port mappings stay active until you stop them.
command.drawerHint: Quick commands are sent to the active terminal and work well for frequent ops and debugging tasks.
command.sensitiveHint: Do not save commands containing passwords, tokens, private-key paths, or Bearer credentials. They are blocked from persistence.
command.sensitiveStoredWarning: This quick command contains sensitive content. Running, copying, and editing are disabled. Delete it and recreate a safe command.
history.drawerHint: Command history is grouped by terminal type and session. Commands containing passwords, tokens, private key paths, or similar secrets are not saved.
help.title: GalaxyTerm Help Center
help.description: Review global shortcuts, session actions, audit recording, and extension entry points. Shortcuts do not fire inside text fields or terminal search.
help.quickOpenHint: Press ? for help anytime. Press {shortcut} to open the command palette and search connections, sessions, commands, or pages.
help.workflow.connections: Save SSH, local, and extension connections, then filter by group, favorite, or type before opening a terminal.
help.workflow.sessions: Terminal tabs keep running across pages. A session ends only when you close its tab.
help.workflow.audit: Use the session menu to save audit records. The audit page can replay, export logs, or export recordings.
help.workflow.extensions: The core package stays lightweight. K8s, Docker, Redis, and database terminals arrive through extensions.
